description: This file contains unit tests for the SubjectCreated class, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling related to the SubjectCreated event in the policy signals component.

classes.name: SubjectCreatedTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying the behavior and properties of the SubjectCreated event class.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that SubjectCreated and its related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Ensures that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for SubjectCreated.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating a SubjectCreated instance with null policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Tests that creating a SubjectCreated instance with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Tests that creating a SubjectCreated instance with null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubject
methods.description: Tests that creating a SubjectCreated instance with null subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that a SubjectCreated instance can be correctly created from a valid JSON.
